name: Parakeet Unified-EN 0.6b Buffer Interval Sweep on gold-92 (t0017)
short_description: Per-clip streaming buffer interval sweep predictions for parakeet-unified-en-0.6b on gold-92 (93 clips), testing 200/300/350/500/750/1000ms extraction intervals with fixed GPU-PB TurboBias domain biasing.
model_description: nvidia/parakeet-unified-en-0.6b (NeMo ASR, unified streaming decoder, 0.6B params) with GPU-PB TurboBias boosting using Rezolve 31-term domain vocabulary expanded to 72 casing variants, alpha=1.0.
prediction_schema: Each line is a JSON object with fields: clip_id (string), duration_s (float), transcript (string), reference_text (string), is_empty (bool), is_hallucination (bool), ttfd_seconds (float), latency_seconds (float), interval_ms (int), n_chunks (int), n_inferences (int).
